user.title: Add a printer
user.description: Name your printer, choose its camera and printer entities, then choose AI tasks and a notification action. Add one integration entry for each printer.

data_description.name: The name shown on the diagnostic sensor and in alerts.
data_description.camera: Choose an available camera that shows this printer and provides JPEG images.
data_description.ai_task: Choose an AI Task to compare camera frames. It must support images and structured data. Its provider receives camera frames and printer data and may charge for requests.
data_description.screen_ai_task: Choose a separate AI Task to check the first frame, or leave this empty to use the comparison task. If selected, it won't fall back to the comparison task when unavailable.
data_description.notify_service: Choose a notify action that accepts a title and message, for example notify.example_phone. Setup won't send a test alert.
data_description.print_status: Choose the sensor that reports running while a print is active.
data_description.current_stage: Choose the sensor that reports printing during the printable stage.
data_description.online: Choose the binary sensor that reports on when this printer is connected.
data_description.print_error: Choose the binary sensor that reports off when this printer has no error.
data_description.task_name: Choose the sensor that identifies the current print job.
data_description.start_time: Choose the sensor that identifies when the current print job started.
data_description.current_layer: Choose a sensor for the current layer, or leave this empty. Its value is sent with camera frames.
data_description.total_layer_count: Choose a sensor for the total layer count, or leave this empty. Its value is sent with camera frames.
data_description.print_progress: Choose a sensor for print progress, or leave this empty. Its value is sent with camera frames.
data_description.nozzle_temperature: Choose a sensor for the nozzle temperature, or leave this empty. Its value is sent with camera frames.
data_description.bed_temperature: Choose a sensor for the bed temperature, or leave this empty. Its value is sent with camera frames.

error.invalid_config: Check the printer name, required entities, AI Task and notification action. Make sure each entity has the right type and is used for only one printer role.
error.printer_conflict: This printer or one of its entities is already used by another Printer Guard configuration. Remove the existing configuration before adding it again.
error.missing_media: Set homeassistant.media_dirs.local to an existing, writable local directory using its full path, then restart Home Assistant.
error.missing_entity: This entity wasn't found. Set it up first or choose another.
error.unavailable_entity: This entity is unavailable. Restore it or choose another before saving.
error.unsupported_ai_task: Choose an AI Task that supports structured data and image attachments.
error.missing_notify_service: This notification action wasn't found. Set it up first or choose another.
